summary: Frontend-only verification of Obserra auth logo (eye+keyhole), branded splash overlay, PWA install banner, and login flow. All targeted checks passed on the public preview URL.

auth_page_logo.notes: Eye outline with keyhole (round top + tapered stem) inside ring is rendered large and centered above the OBSERRA wordmark and 'Executive Protection & Intelligence LLC' tagline. Confirmed on 1440x900 and 375x812 viewports.

splash_overlay.notes: Overlay renders on mount, fades at 1.2s, removed by 1.8s; sessionStorage 'obserra-splash-seen' prevents re-display within the session. Does not permanently block the UI.

install_banner.notes: beforeinstallprompt did not fire in headless Chromium; banner correctly stays hidden and produces no errors. Component is gated behind the browser event and localStorage 'obserra-install-dismissed'.

login_flow.notes: Sign In with email+password redirects to /app dashboard; logo/splash changes did not regress auth.

test_results.console_observations: Only unrelated pre-login 401s on /api/auth/me (expected while unauthenticated). No errors from Splash or InstallBanner components.

critical_code_review_comments: Splash.jsx: cleanup runs on unmount but sessionStorage is only set at t2=1800ms; if the user navigates away during 0-1800ms the flag won't be set and splash will show again on next mount within the same session. Minor UX nit — safe to leave as-is.
InstallBanner.jsx: dismissing via 'X' is permanent (localStorage flag with no expiry). Consider TTL (e.g., 30 days) so returning users can be re-prompted after major updates.

obserra-mark.svg: no explicit width/height attributes on <svg>; sizing depends entirely on the consumer. Current usage relies on Tailwind h-* classes which works, but adding width='256' height='256' would improve robustness if the mark is embedded elsewhere.
Splash overlay uses z-[9999] and InstallBanner z-[9998]; both are above any potential modal — acceptable here but be aware if future modals need to sit above them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth logo bug (arrow inner symbol) is resolved — /obserra-mark.svg now renders eye+keyhole correctly. Splash appears on first load only (sessionStorage 'obserra-splash-seen'); to re-test, clear sessionStorage or open a fresh context. Install banner cannot be reliably validated in headless Chromium because 'beforeinstallprompt' doesn't fire — treat absence as PASS per product owner. Login credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
